The second operand is an absolute path to the  enabled  leaf of all areas, with no predicate binding to the interface's own area. Since XPath node-set = 'false'  is existential, the constraint is violated whenever the interface flag is  true  and any area anywhere has  enabled = 'false' .  The  description  states the intent is the interface's "OSPF area level capability," which argues for a relative path up to the containing area.

So correct /rt:routing/rt:control-plane-protocols/rt:control-plane-protocol/ospf:ospf/ospf:areas/ospf:area/  to  ../../../

Erratum EID 9289 (Verified) corrected the "must" statement of leaf advertise-unreachable-link in Section 4.2.5. The enclosing interface augment's "when" statement has two further XPath defects that cause standards-compliant YANG 1.1 validators (RFC 7950) to reject advertise-unreachable-link on every valid OSPF configuration:

1. Per RFC 7950 Section 10.4.1, derived-from() returns true only if the first argument is strictly derived from, and NOT equal to, the identity in the second argument. In standard configurations rt:type is set to the identity "ietf-ospf:ospfv2" or "ietf-ospf:ospfv3" itself (RFC 9129), so both derived-from() calls evaluate to false and the augmented leaf can never be instantiated. The area-level augment in the same module (Section 4.2.5) already uses derived-from-or-self(../../../rt:type, 'ospf:ospfv2') or derived-from-or-self(../../../rt:type, 'ospf:ospfv3'), as does RFC 9129.

2. The absolute path /rt:routing/rt:control-plane-protocols/rt:control-plane-protocol/rt:type has no predicate binding it to the enclosing control-plane-protocol instance. The relative path ../../../../../rt:type (ospf:interface -> ospf:interfaces -> ospf:area -> ospf:areas -> ospf:ospf -> rt:control-plane-protocol) scopes the check to the augmented protocol instance, consistent with the area-level augment.

Verified with the yangson YANG 1.1 datastore validator: with EID 9289 applied, a configuration setting advertise-unreachable-link = true on an interface of an area with unreachable-link-advertisement/enabled = true is rejected ("member-not-allowed") for both rt:type = ietf-ospf:ospfv2 and ospfv3; with the corrected text both are accepted, the "must" constraint still rejects enabled = false, and pyang --ietf reports no errors.
